title: Test audit and screenshot evidence
summary: Before-and-after evidence for the requested audit name and README correction, and the rule requiring screenshot evidence and traceability.

changes.title: Name and document the test audit
changes.problem: The audit name was long and described the rules as if they came from users. The README mixed French and English.
changes.decision: Use sg-test-audit and explain how AI-generated shortcuts can hide broken actions behind passing tests. Use English in both READMEs.
changes.impact: The change view shows the English heading, new skill name and explanation at the tested revision.

changes.title: Require screenshot evidence and traceability
changes.problem: The bug template asked for screenshots only if applicable. The feature template lacked a screenshot field and the pull request template did not identify a matched before-and-after pair.
changes.decision: Ask for observed screenshot evidence in issue templates and paired evidence for the same scenario in pull requests, including non-UI changes.
changes.impact: The revised templates visibly request the screenshot, revision, reproduction conditions, observed result and underlying proof.
